# Rule index

Every graded rule, with its level and proof (152 MUST, 231 SHOULD, 6 MAY). Open a rule's ID for its section.

Proof kinds: **browser** — real browser interaction ([browser proof](./ACCEPTANCE.md#browser-proof));
**recording** — continuous recording ([motion over time](./ACCEPTANCE.md#review-motion-over-time));
**unit** — a unit or state test in the host; **review** — inspection of the change itself;
`check:<id>` — a `verify:design` rule; `test:<path>` — a named test (paths from the repository root).

| ID                                                                                           | Level  | Rule                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | Proof           |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------- |
| [D-COLOR-1](./DESIGN.md#1-color--a-state-ladder-not-a-palette)                               | SHOULD | Choose semantic roles for content, surfaces, boundaries, actions and status.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |                 |
| [D-COLOR-2](./DESIGN.md#1-color--a-state-ladder-not-a-palette)                               | SHOULD | Define default, hover, active, disabled and focus states together.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |                 |
| [D-COLOR-3](./DESIGN.md#1-color--a-state-ladder-not-a-palette)                               | SHOULD | Resolve light/dark values through the host’s authoritative tokens, and verify contrast in the actual composition.                                                                                                                                                                                                   |                 |
| [D-SPACE-1](./DESIGN.md#2-spacing--a-limited-rhythmic-scale)                                 | SHOULD | Use the host’s existing spacing scale.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |                 |
| [D-SPACE-2](./DESIGN.md#2-spacing--a-limited-rhythmic-scale)                                 | SHOULD | Use tight gaps to group related parts and larger gaps to separate tasks or regions.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |                 |
| [D-SPACE-3](./DESIGN.md#2-spacing--a-limited-rhythmic-scale)                                 | SHOULD | Establish inside padding before outside gaps.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |                 |
| [D-SPACE-4](./DESIGN.md#2-spacing--a-limited-rhythmic-scale)                                 | SHOULD | Do not copy a reference product’s dimensions without evaluating content, density and input method.                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |                 |
| [D-TYPE-1](./DESIGN.md#3-typography--choose-a-role-not-a-size)                               | SHOULD | Choose heading, label, body, action and code roles with coherent size, weight and line height, and keep a single authority for each role.                                                                                                                                                                           |                 |
| [D-TYPE-2](./DESIGN.md#3-typography--choose-a-role-not-a-size)                               | SHOULD | Verify actual scripts, fallback metrics and long content.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |                 |
| [D-TYPE-3](./DESIGN.md#3-typography--choose-a-role-not-a-size)                               | SHOULD | Establish hierarchy with typography before decorative containers.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |                 |
| [D-ELEV-1](./DESIGN.md#4-radius--elevation)                                                  | SHOULD | Coordinate nested corner radii with their real inset: inner radius = outer radius − inset. When the result is 2px or less, the shapes no longer read as concentric; give the inner shape its own role radius, or none.                                                                                              |                 |
| [D-ELEV-2](./DESIGN.md#4-radius--elevation)                                                  | SHOULD | Use elevation to explain a floating layer, not importance, through the host’s stacking roles, and verify overlays against surrounding chrome.                                                                                                                                                                       |                 |
| [D-MOTION-1](./DESIGN.md#5-motion--prefer-none)                                              | SHOULD | Use the host system’s motion tokens and verify frequency, continuity and reduced motion in the actual task.                                                                                                                                                                                                         |                 |
| [D-MOTION-2](./DESIGN.md#5-motion--prefer-none)                                              | SHOULD | Default repeated interaction to immediate feedback; a larger change is not automatically a reason to animate.                                                                                                                                                                                                       |                 |
| [D-MOTION-3](./DESIGN.md#5-motion--prefer-none)                                              | SHOULD | Use existing tokens for purposeful motion and keep it quick and interruptible. Reduced motion is graded under D-MOTION-10 and D-ACCESS-5.                                                                                                                                                                           |                 |
| [D-MOTION-4](./DESIGN.md#functional-motion-contract)                                         | SHOULD | Specify the trigger, state change and destination before choosing an effect.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |                 |
| [D-MOTION-5](./DESIGN.md#functional-motion-contract)                                         | MUST   | Motion preserves unrelated content, drafts and reading position.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | recording       |
| [D-MOTION-6](./DESIGN.md#functional-motion-contract)                                         | SHOULD | Give sibling components with the same interaction meaning a shared motion language; consistency does not require every component to animate.                                                                                                                                                                        |                 |
| [D-MOTION-7](./DESIGN.md#functional-motion-contract)                                         | MUST   | When motion is used, a new intent can interrupt or reverse it from the current presentation, without a jump, stale completion or duplicate activation.                                                                                                                                                              | recording       |
| [D-MOTION-8](./DESIGN.md#functional-motion-contract)                                         | MUST   | Feedback stays immediate; animation is not an input lock.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | recording       |
| [D-MOTION-9](./DESIGN.md#functional-motion-contract)                                         | SHOULD | During insertion/removal, avoid visibly squeezing text or passing exiting controls across live actions; coordinate opacity and layout so the result stays readable.                                                                                                                                                 |                 |
| [D-MOTION-10](./DESIGN.md#functional-motion-contract)                                        | MUST   | Reduced motion retains a visible, understandable final state.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | browser         |
| [D-MOTION-11](./DESIGN.md#functional-motion-contract)                                        | MAY    | Use a spring; it need not overshoot.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |                 |
| [D-MOTION-12](./DESIGN.md#functional-motion-contract)                                        | SHOULD | Let theme palettes settle coherently. Avoid implicit palette fades or `transition: all`; opt in explicitly only where the host intends and verifies a coordinated effect.                                                                                                                                           |                 |
| [D-MOTION-13](./DESIGN.md#functional-motion-contract)                                        | MUST   | Factual values and readable content are shown immediately on return to a working surface, without animated counts.                                                                                                                                                                                                  | browser         |
| [D-MOTION-16](./DESIGN.md#functional-motion-contract)                                        | SHOULD | Do not replay decorative title entrances on each return to a working surface.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |                 |
| [D-MOTION-17](./DESIGN.md#functional-motion-contract)                                        | SHOULD | Choose entrance motion by what a region holds, from the table below. Stagger in reading order inside one region, not across the page.                                                                                                                                                                               |                 |
| [D-MOTION-14](./DESIGN.md#functional-motion-contract)                                        | MAY    | A loading demonstration may move to demonstrate loading.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |                 |
| [D-MOTION-15](./DESIGN.md#functional-motion-contract)                                        | MUST   | A status pulse appears only while the activity is live.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | review          |
| [D-COPY-1](./DESIGN.md#6-content--copy-is-part-of-the-system)                                | SHOULD | Buttons name the outcome. Include the object when context does not establish it: "Deploy project", "Delete member". In a clearly named object or dialog, "Save" or "Delete" is sufficient; avoid generic "OK". See [contextual wording](./DESIGN.md#words-are-part-of-the-interface).                               |                 |
| [D-COPY-2](./DESIGN.md#6-content--copy-is-part-of-the-system)                                | SHOULD | Errors say **what happened**, then **how to fix it**. ✅ "Build failed: the bundle exceeds the size limit. Reduce it or raise the limit." ❌ "Operation failed, please try again."                                                                                                                                  |                 |
| [D-COPY-3](./DESIGN.md#6-content--copy-is-part-of-the-system)                                | SHOULD | Confirmations and toasts state the completed **change**. ✅ "Project deleted". ❌ "Operation successful".                                                                                                                                                                                                           |                 |
| [D-COPY-4](./DESIGN.md#6-content--copy-is-part-of-the-system)                                | MUST   | Show completion feedback only after the operation is confirmed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | unit, browser   |
| [D-COPY-5](./DESIGN.md#6-content--copy-is-part-of-the-system)                                | SHOULD | Be specific; every sentence removes guesswork rather than adding it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |                 |
| [D-ACCESS-1](./DESIGN.md#7-accessibility--the-system-serves-everyone)                        | MUST   | Text keeps sufficient contrast with its background (**WCAG AA**).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | browser         |
| [D-ACCESS-2](./DESIGN.md#7-accessibility--the-system-serves-everyone)                        | MUST   | Never signal state with color alone; pair it with an icon or text (e.g. ✓ / ✕ labels, not just green/red).                                                                                                                                                                                                          | review          |
| [D-ACCESS-3](./DESIGN.md#7-accessibility--the-system-serves-everyone)                        | MUST   | Every interactive element has a **visible focus ring** appropriate to its surface; never remove it for "cleanliness".                                                                                                                                                                                               | browser         |
| [D-ACCESS-4](./DESIGN.md#7-accessibility--the-system-serves-everyone)                        | MUST   | **Full keyboard navigation**: nothing is mouse-only.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | browser         |
| [D-ACCESS-5](./DESIGN.md#7-accessibility--the-system-serves-everyone)                        | MUST   | Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | browser         |
| [D-ACCESS-6](./DESIGN.md#7-accessibility--the-system-serves-everyone)                        | MUST   | When the host supports both schemes, the initial render follows `prefers-color-scheme`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | browser         |
| [D-INPUT-1](./DESIGN.md#8-input--viewport--mobile-and-desktop-both)                          | MUST   | Support mouse, keyboard and touch at narrow and wide widths.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | browser         |
| [D-INPUT-2](./DESIGN.md#8-input--viewport--mobile-and-desktop-both)                          | MUST   | Reflow controls instead of hiding the only route to an action.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | browser         |
| [D-INPUT-3](./DESIGN.md#8-input--viewport--mobile-and-desktop-both)                          | MUST   | A hover affordance has a click/tap alternative.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | browser         |
| [D-INPUT-4](./DESIGN.md#8-input--viewport--mobile-and-desktop-both)                          | MUST   | Drags use Pointer Events, including cancellation.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | browser         |
| [D-INPUT-5](./DESIGN.md#8-input--viewport--mobile-and-desktop-both)                          | MUST   | Scope `touch-action` to the actual drag surface and pair it with a real handler; ordinary scrolling keeps working elsewhere.                                                                                                                                                                                        | browser         |
| [D-INPUT-6](./DESIGN.md#8-input--viewport--mobile-and-desktop-both)                          | SHOULD | Prefer content/viewport-relative bounds (`min()`, `max()`, `clamp()`) to arbitrary breakpoints.                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |                 |
| [D-INPUT-7](./DESIGN.md#8-input--viewport--mobile-and-desktop-both)                          | SHOULD | Use existing host breakpoints, and introduce a justified shared role only when repeated needs emerge.                                                                                                                                                                                                               |                 |
| [D-INPUT-8](./DESIGN.md#8-input--viewport--mobile-and-desktop-both)                          | SHOULD | Exercise resizing into a narrow layout, not only loading there.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |                 |
| [D-INPUT-9](./DESIGN.md#8-input--viewport--mobile-and-desktop-both)                          | MUST   | Overlay placement tracks its trigger while open.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | browser         |
| [D-INPUT-10](./DESIGN.md#8-input--viewport--mobile-and-desktop-both)                         | SHOULD | Test actual pointer/touch gestures, hover fallback and keyboard routes where affected; checking two color schemes does not establish input parity.                                                                                                                                                                  |                 |
| [D-COMP-1](./DESIGN.md#9-composition--the-page-not-the-component)                            | SHOULD | Choose the page structure in §10 first; then compose its components with these rules.                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |                 |
| [D-COMP-2](./DESIGN.md#style-coherence-across-components-and-pages)                          | SHOULD | Before implementation, record a short design brief in the existing task note or product design owner. Use the existing system; a small fix only needs the affected decisions. The brief settles each applicable decision in the table below (D-COMP-2).                                                             |                 |
| [D-COMP-4](./DESIGN.md#style-coherence-across-components-and-pages)                          | SHOULD | Reuse the brief across sibling components and docs chrome; change emphasis according to the task.                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |                 |
| [D-COMP-5](./DESIGN.md#style-coherence-across-components-and-pages)                          | SHOULD | Keep an expressive demo visibly distinct from its documentation chrome.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |                 |
| [D-COMP-6](./DESIGN.md#style-coherence-across-components-and-pages)                          | SHOULD | Update the brief before changing the visual direction; do not silently rewrite the standard to justify an implementation that failed review.                                                                                                                                                                        |                 |
| [D-COMP-7](./DESIGN.md#style-coherence-across-components-and-pages)                          | SHOULD | Compare a representative composed still with different real content before animating it, then inspect the state change and return path at normal speed.                                                                                                                                                             |                 |
| [D-COMP-8](./DESIGN.md#style-coherence-across-components-and-pages)                          | SHOULD | When an example looks imported from another product, fix that relationship at its owning token/component/style rather than adding a page-specific patch.                                                                                                                                                            |                 |
| [D-COMP-9](./DESIGN.md#style-coherence-across-components-and-pages)                          | SHOULD | Keep reference observations and validation limits in the optional [research index](./REFERENCE_RESEARCH.md#style-coherence-and-transition-research).                                                                                                                                                                |                 |
| [D-BOX-1](./DESIGN.md#structure-before-containers)                                           | SHOULD | **Reach for spacing, alignment, weight and a hairline before a box.**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |                 |
| [D-BOX-2](./DESIGN.md#structure-before-containers)                                           | SHOULD | Reserve a box for **a genuinely separate object**: a live demo stage, an overlay, a panel that floats. Not for a code block, a table, a list row, a previous/next link, or a cell in a gallery.                                                                                                                     |                 |
| [D-BOX-3](./DESIGN.md#structure-before-containers)                                           | SHOULD | **Avoid redundant nested containers and doubled padding.** A card inside a padded panel does not need another decorative frame or inset.                                                                                                                                                                            |                 |
| [D-BOX-4](./DESIGN.md#structure-before-containers)                                           | SHOULD | Keep functionally required nested controls or surfaces, and coordinate their radii with the actual inset; containment alone is not a reason to add a box.                                                                                                                                                           |                 |
| [D-BOX-5](./DESIGN.md#structure-before-containers)                                           | SHOULD | **Every persistent boundary needs a distinct job.** Start with headings, alignment and proximity to group content. Add a border, surface fill or elevation only when that structure leaves a real boundary unclear.                                                                                                 |                 |
| [D-BOX-6](./DESIGN.md#structure-before-containers)                                           | SHOULD | Do not repeat the same grouping with a panel frame, a nested card, row rules and another inset at the same time.                                                                                                                                                                                                    |                 |
| [D-BOX-8](./DESIGN.md#structure-before-containers)                                           | MUST   | Keep keyboard focus and persistent selection cues; never remove them to make the resting layout quieter.                                                                                                                                                                                                            | browser         |
| [D-BOX-9](./DESIGN.md#structure-before-containers)                                           | SHOULD | Review the full pane or page, not only the cropped group. For every remaining stable outline, fill or separator, name the relationship or interaction it communicates and check what becomes ambiguous if it is removed.                                                                                            |                 |
| [D-COMP-10](./DESIGN.md#emphasis-is-a-budget)                                                | SHOULD | Establish priority with structure and proximity first, and spend emphasis on the one thing that deserves it.                                                                                                                                                                                                        |                 |
| [D-ELEV-3](./DESIGN.md#emphasis-is-a-budget)                                                 | SHOULD | Reserve shadows for surfaces that genuinely float above content: popovers, menus, dialogs, notifications. Do not shadow every card.                                                                                                                                                                                 |                 |
| [D-SPACE-6](./DESIGN.md#spacing-carries-meaning)                                             | SHOULD | Do not undo a gap's relationship with a decorative divider.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |                 |
| [D-SPACE-7](./DESIGN.md#vertical-rhythm-across-sibling-views)                                | SHOULD | Repeat relationships, not fixed heights. Choose title/description, field/hint, group and region gaps from the host scale according to their relationship.                                                                                                                                                           |                 |
| [D-SPACE-8](./DESIGN.md#vertical-rhythm-across-sibling-views)                                | SHOULD | Let translations grow naturally, and leave no vacant row for a missing description.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |                 |
| [D-SPACE-9](./DESIGN.md#vertical-rhythm-across-sibling-views)                                | SHOULD | Give each gap one owner: parent stack or explicit child margin. Reset authored local heading/paragraph margins rather than adding them to the parent's gap.                                                                                                                                                         |                 |
| [D-SPACE-10](./DESIGN.md#vertical-rhythm-across-sibling-views)                               | SHOULD | Account for owned control padding, collapsing margins and inline baseline space; do not compensate with transforms or smaller type.                                                                                                                                                                                 |                 |
| [D-SPACE-11](./DESIGN.md#vertical-rhythm-across-sibling-views)                               | SHOULD | Place hints with the field/action they explain.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |                 |
| [D-SPACE-12](./DESIGN.md#vertical-rhythm-across-sibling-views)                               | MUST   | Hidden helpers leave no accidental gap.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | browser         |
| [D-SPACE-16](./DESIGN.md#vertical-rhythm-across-sibling-views)                               | SHOULD | A reserved async status line has a stated purpose and bounds. Measure both axes after content settles; [ACCEPTANCE](./ACCEPTANCE.md) grades this as V-PROOF-6.                                                                                                                                                      |                 |
| [D-SPACE-14](./DESIGN.md#vertical-rhythm-across-sibling-views)                               | SHOULD | Keep leading, padding and hairlines distinct: 16px padding plus a 1px rule is not a 17px spacing token.                                                                                                                                                                                                             |                 |
| [D-SPACE-15](./DESIGN.md#vertical-rhythm-across-sibling-views)                               | SHOULD | Use independent expectations and exercise wrapping, resizing, helper/error visibility and relevant density.                                                                                                                                                                                                         |                 |
| [D-TYPE-4](./DESIGN.md#the-measure-governs-text-not-the-column)                              | SHOULD | **Choose a readable measure for the actual script and font.**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |                 |
| [D-TYPE-5](./DESIGN.md#the-measure-governs-text-not-the-column)                              | SHOULD | Review realistic text at supported widths, zoom levels and font fallbacks; CJK and mixed-script text need their own judgment.                                                                                                                                                                                       |                 |
| [D-TYPE-6](./DESIGN.md#the-measure-governs-text-not-the-column)                              | SHOULD | Let a table, code fence, demo stage or image retain the width its content needs. Cap the text elements, not the column that holds them.                                                                                                                                                                             |                 |
| [D-TYPE-7](./DESIGN.md#the-measure-governs-text-not-the-column)                              | SHOULD | **Declare the measure in `rem`, never `em`.**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |                 |
| [D-TYPE-8](./DESIGN.md#the-measure-governs-text-not-the-column)                              | SHOULD | **Build hierarchy out of type before reaching for a box.**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |                 |
| [D-ALIGN-1](./DESIGN.md#if-the-layout-says-two-things-are-one-object-the-spacing-must-agree) | SHOULD | Decide whether the elements are one object or two, and make every property say the same thing.                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |                 |
| [D-ALIGN-2](./DESIGN.md#if-the-layout-says-two-things-are-one-object-the-spacing-must-agree) | SHOULD | **When a value must equal another value, name it.** A gap that a child has to subtract is not a literal in two places; it is one custom property referenced twice.                                                                                                                                                  |                 |
| [D-ALIGN-3](./DESIGN.md#reserve-a-column-only-when-its-content-exists)                       | SHOULD | Condition the track on the element actually being there (`:has()`), not on a page type you assume implies it.                                                                                                                                                                                                       |                 |
| [D-ALIGN-4](./DESIGN.md#alignment-is-structure-not-polish)                                   | SHOULD | **Name each alignment spine and the geometry it aligns.** State which siblings share each one; include headers, body copy, rows, actions and empty/loading/error content.                                                                                                                                           |                 |
| [D-ALIGN-5](./DESIGN.md#alignment-is-structure-not-polish)                                   | SHOULD | A back button plus gap may establish a separate title column: do not silently treat that title as aligned to body text.                                                                                                                                                                                             |                 |
| [D-ALIGN-6](./DESIGN.md#alignment-is-structure-not-polish)                                   | MUST   | A missing optional icon or badge never moves labels out of their declared column.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | browser         |
| [D-ALIGN-7](./DESIGN.md#alignment-is-structure-not-polish)                                   | SHOULD | A nested level returns exactly to its parent's spine when it ends. Compare the right boxes. These are separate measurements, even when they happen to coincide; measuring the defect's layer is graded in [ACCEPTANCE](./ACCEPTANCE.md) as V-PROOF-10.                                                              |                 |
| [D-ALIGN-9](./DESIGN.md#alignment-is-structure-not-polish)                                   | SHOULD | Inspect optical glyph corrections separately. For web components, measure the host, documented shadow parts and slotted text through supported test seams. V-PROOF-11 in [ACCEPTANCE](./ACCEPTANCE.md) owns this, including the ban on production shadow queries and on assuming document CSS crosses the boundary. |                 |
| [D-ALIGN-11](./DESIGN.md#alignment-is-structure-not-polish)                                  | SHOULD | **Keep a header command's hit zone separate from layout filler.** A title/menu trigger hugs its content plus deliberate padding, bounded by the available width. Let a separate flex/grid track absorb remaining space.                                                                                             |                 |
| [D-ALIGN-12](./DESIGN.md#alignment-is-structure-not-polish)                                  | SHOULD | Define truncation/wrapping and adjacent action behavior for long translations.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |                 |
| [D-ALIGN-13](./DESIGN.md#alignment-is-structure-not-polish)                                  | MUST   | The title trigger's hit area does not span unused header space (for example through `flex: 1` on the title button) unless D-ALIGN-14 applies.                                                                                                                                                                       | browser         |
| [D-ALIGN-14](./DESIGN.md#alignment-is-structure-not-polish)                                  | SHOULD | A row that intentionally selects its whole width is a different role; record that contract explicitly.                                                                                                                                                                                                              |                 |
| [D-ALIGN-15](./DESIGN.md#alignment-is-structure-not-polish)                                  | MAY    | Coarse-pointer targets may grow larger.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |                 |
| [D-ALIGN-22](./DESIGN.md#alignment-is-structure-not-polish)                                  | SHOULD | A grown target's hover fill stays on the control's own content, not across unrelated content.                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |                 |
| [D-ALIGN-16](./DESIGN.md#alignment-is-structure-not-polish)                                  | SHOULD | **Count every inset from the shared ancestor to the visible text.** Parent padding, nested panel padding, a control's internal padding, borders and navigation columns all contribute.                                                                                                                              |                 |
| [D-ALIGN-17](./DESIGN.md#alignment-is-structure-not-polish)                                  | SHOULD | Remove a redundant inset at its owner instead of cancelling it with an unexplained negative margin.                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |                 |
| [D-ALIGN-18](./DESIGN.md#alignment-is-structure-not-polish)                                  | SHOULD | Empty states retain their region's content spine and width; extra breathing room never introduces a second left edge or makes a compact action fill the region.                                                                                                                                                     |                 |
| [D-ALIGN-19](./DESIGN.md#alignment-is-structure-not-polish)                                  | SHOULD | Keep product-specific insets and target sizes as application aliases, not new foundation values or universal component defaults.                                                                                                                                                                                    |                 |
| [D-ALIGN-20](./DESIGN.md#alignment-is-structure-not-polish)                                  | SHOULD | **When two layout edges or gaps are meant to be equal, a one-pixel difference is a defect.** Optical glyph correction (D-ALIGN-21) is the only tolerance.                                                                                                                                                           |                 |
| [D-ALIGN-21](./DESIGN.md#alignment-is-structure-not-polish)                                  | SHOULD | Treat optical correction for an asymmetric glyph as a separate, documented asset/component decision, reused at supported sizes while sibling gaps, baselines and spines stay exact.                                                                                                                                 |                 |
| [D-SEM-1](./DESIGN.md#selection-links-and-other-semantic-lies)                               | MUST   | **Selection is persistent state and never looks like hover.**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | browser         |
| [D-SEM-2](./DESIGN.md#selection-links-and-other-semantic-lies)                               | MUST   | **Action and link roles remain distinguishable.**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | browser         |
| [D-SEM-3](./DESIGN.md#selection-links-and-other-semantic-lies)                               | SHOULD | Verify inline links against surrounding prose, including themes where action and body colors happen to match.                                                                                                                                                                                                       |                 |
| [D-SEM-4](./DESIGN.md#selection-links-and-other-semantic-lies)                               | MUST   | Anything that changes application state is a button, whatever it looks like.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | review, browser |
| [D-SEM-5](./DESIGN.md#selection-links-and-other-semantic-lies)                               | SHOULD | A button-shaped link carries no underline.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |                 |
| [D-CMD-1](./DESIGN.md#command-hierarchy-in-constrained-panes)                                | SHOULD | **Remove redundant group enclosures without erasing control affordance.**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |                 |
| [D-CMD-2](./DESIGN.md#command-hierarchy-in-constrained-panes)                                | SHOULD | Use flat rows when a recognizable menu/list pattern already conveys action; do not require them in every context.                                                                                                                                                                                                   |                 |
| [D-CMD-3](./DESIGN.md#command-hierarchy-in-constrained-panes)                                | SHOULD | Give a standalone command that needs it its own restrained button surface or functional stroke, visible before hover in every supported theme.                                                                                                                                                                      |                 |
| [D-CMD-4](./DESIGN.md#command-hierarchy-in-constrained-panes)                                | SHOULD | Let a button's own shape identify its target; an enclosing card, muted group fill and row rules still pass the distinct-boundary test (D-BOX-5).                                                                                                                                                                    |                 |
| [D-CMD-5](./DESIGN.md#command-hierarchy-in-constrained-panes)                                | MUST   | Initial discovery does not rely on hover, pointer cursors, verb labels or keyboard focus alone.                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | browser         |
| [D-CMD-6](./DESIGN.md#command-hierarchy-in-constrained-panes)                                | SHOULD | Inspect the resting full pane with the pointer away, including touch use.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |                 |
| [D-CMD-7](./DESIGN.md#command-hierarchy-in-constrained-panes)                                | MUST   | Hover, press, disabled and keyboard focus stay distinguishable after the control is discovered.                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | browser         |
| [D-CMD-8](./DESIGN.md#command-hierarchy-in-constrained-panes)                                | SHOULD | Wrap long translated labels inside one command column instead of a ragged horizontal button cloud.                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |                 |
| [D-CMD-9](./DESIGN.md#command-hierarchy-in-constrained-panes)                                | MUST   | Do not add navigation chevrons to immediate commands.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | review          |
| [D-CMD-10](./DESIGN.md#command-hierarchy-in-constrained-panes)                               | SHOULD | Declare which visible columns are shared with adjacent checkboxes or controls: measure icon/checkbox edges and text Ranges, not only button rectangles or alignment within the command group.                                                                                                                       |                 |
| [D-CMD-11](./DESIGN.md#command-hierarchy-in-constrained-panes)                               | MAY    | A hit target may extend into an owned gutter to preserve those columns; name the extension.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |                 |
| [D-CMD-12](./DESIGN.md#command-hierarchy-in-constrained-panes)                               | MUST   | An extended hit target stays inside its pane, does not overlap other targets, and keeps focus visible.                                                                                                                                                                                                              | browser         |
| [D-CMD-13](./DESIGN.md#command-hierarchy-in-constrained-panes)                               | SHOULD | Separate destructive commands from recovery and transfer actions.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |                 |
| [D-CMD-14](./DESIGN.md#command-hierarchy-in-constrained-panes)                               | SHOULD | Let a danger label and icon communicate intent without a large red outline on every resting command; reserve the strongest danger fill for explicit confirmation.                                                                                                                                                   |                 |
| [D-CMD-15](./DESIGN.md#command-hierarchy-in-constrained-panes)                               | MUST   | Destructive commands keep confirmation, cancellation, focus return and busy guards.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | browser         |
| [D-CMD-16](./DESIGN.md#command-hierarchy-in-constrained-panes)                               | SHOULD | Accept a command pane against its resting state, not only its hover state.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |                 |
| [D-CMD-17](./DESIGN.md#command-hierarchy-in-constrained-panes)                               | SHOULD | Inspect the actual render as well: an automated surface-difference check catches invisible control fills but does not prove that users recognize the action.                                                                                                                                                        |                 |
| [D-CMD-18](./DESIGN.md#command-hierarchy-in-constrained-panes)                               | SHOULD | Reuse foundation roles and coarse-input target requirements; this guidance changes no component defaults.                                                                                                                                                                                                           |                 |
| [D-TOKEN-1](./DESIGN.md#one-product-one-token-set)                                           | SHOULD | Use the product’s authoritative semantic tokens. Aliases may improve readability, but resolve from that source rather than inventing a competing palette.                                                                                                                                                           |                 |
| [D-TOKEN-2](./DESIGN.md#one-product-one-token-set)                                           | SHOULD | Coordinate third-party components through supported theme APIs and verify the composed result.                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |                 |
| [D-TOKEN-3](./DESIGN.md#density-follows-control-roles)                                       | SHOULD | Measure actual hit bounds, focus and adjacent gaps.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |                 |
| [D-TOKEN-4](./DESIGN.md#density-follows-control-roles)                                       | SHOULD | Derive repeated host aliases from foundation tokens, not one application's dimensions copied across the library.                                                                                                                                                                                                    |                 |
| [D-TOKEN-5](./DESIGN.md#density-follows-control-roles)                                       | SHOULD | Choose target bounds for the actual input method without enlarging every glyph or reserving space for hidden controls. Use supported public theme APIs.                                                                                                                                                             |                 |
| [D-TOKEN-6](./DESIGN.md#density-follows-control-roles)                                       | MUST   | Name icon-only controls accessibly.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | browser         |
| [D-TOKEN-7](./DESIGN.md#density-follows-control-roles)                                       | SHOULD | Document legitimate viewport, hairline, artwork and optical geometry exceptions.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |                 |
| [D-CRAFT-1](./DESIGN.md#evaluate-craft-through-evidence)                                     | SHOULD | Choose a deliberate visual direction using realistic objects, copy and states; a generic empty shell cannot establish product quality.                                                                                                                                                                              |                 |
| [D-CRAFT-2](./DESIGN.md#evaluate-craft-through-evidence)                                     | SHOULD | Evaluate the smallest intervention against real content, language, device and repeated use.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |                 |
| [D-CRAFT-3](./DESIGN.md#evaluate-craft-through-evidence)                                     | SHOULD | Adapt their principles with the host’s tokens and actual capabilities; do not copy a product's pixel sizes or import recipes as rules.                                                                                                                                                                              |                 |
| [D-CRAFT-4](./DESIGN.md#evaluate-craft-through-evidence)                                     | SHOULD | Treat references as inputs to decisions, not additional instruction sets; for example, [Don't Make Me Think](https://sensible.com/dont-make-me-think/) informs scanning, hierarchy and clear choices.                                                                                                               |                 |
| [D-CRAFT-5](./DESIGN.md#evaluate-craft-through-evidence)                                     | SHOULD | A stylistic preference needs context; a requirement identifies the task or observable contract it protects.                                                                                                                                                                                                         |                 |
| [D-CRAFT-6](./DESIGN.md#evaluate-craft-through-evidence)                                     | SHOULD | Choose references by the job they support: logo/app identity, marketing composition and frequent working interactions solve different problems.                                                                                                                                                                     |                 |
| [D-CRAFT-7](./DESIGN.md#evaluate-craft-through-evidence)                                     | SHOULD | Record the observed pattern and its adaptation; verify the result with real content.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |                 |
| [D-CRAFT-8](./DESIGN.md#evaluate-craft-through-evidence)                                     | SHOULD | When direction is unresolved, compare two small real-host variants with the same content, width and theme, changing one dimension at a time. Explain what each difference does for the task.                                                                                                                        |                 |
| [D-CRAFT-9](./DESIGN.md#evaluate-craft-through-evidence)                                     | SHOULD | Balance short headings progressively with `text-wrap: balance`, preserving normal wrapping.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |                 |
| [D-CRAFT-10](./DESIGN.md#evaluate-craft-through-evidence)                                    | MUST   | Headings contain no locale-dependent manual line breaks and are not clipped to preserve a screenshot.                                                                                                                                                                                                               | browser         |
| [D-CRAFT-11](./DESIGN.md#evaluate-craft-through-evidence)                                    | SHOULD | Check cost and support before using `pretty` on long live content.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |                 |
| [D-CRAFT-12](./DESIGN.md#evaluate-craft-through-evidence)                                    | SHOULD | Use tabular figures to stabilize digit advances if the font supports them.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |                 |
| [D-CRAFT-13](./DESIGN.md#evaluate-craft-through-evidence)                                    | SHOULD | Reserve a meaningful column for digit-count changes such as 99 → 100.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |                 |
| [D-CRAFT-14](./DESIGN.md#evaluate-craft-through-evidence)                                    | MUST   | A digit-count change never truncates the value.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | browser         |
| [D-CRAFT-15](./DESIGN.md#evaluate-craft-through-evidence)                                    | SHOULD | Correct asymmetric glyphs in a reusable asset/component, preserving exact layout spines.                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |                 |
| [D-CRAFT-16](./DESIGN.md#evaluate-craft-through-evidence)                                    | SHOULD | Derive nested corner geometry from actual inset; remove an unnecessary nested surface first.                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |                 |
| [D-CRAFT-17](./DESIGN.md#evaluate-craft-through-evidence)                                    | SHOULD | Give motion a job: immediate frequent feedback, interruptible transitions, reduced motion and instant themes. See §5.                                                                                                                                                                                               |                 |
| [D-CRAFT-18](./DESIGN.md#evaluate-craft-through-evidence)                                    | MUST   | Optional delight never delays typing or obscures status.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | recording       |
| [D-CRAFT-19](./DESIGN.md#evaluate-craft-through-evidence)                                    | SHOULD | Pause offscreen decoration and profile realistic content before adopting costly effects.                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |                 |
| [D-COPY-6](./DESIGN.md#words-are-part-of-the-interface)                                      | SHOULD | Avoid unnecessary secondary labels and descriptions. Let the layout do the explaining.                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |                 |
| [D-COPY-7](./DESIGN.md#words-are-part-of-the-interface)                                      | SHOULD | A heading, grouping, proximity or obvious control needs no other sentence repeating its purpose.                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |                 |
| [D-COPY-8](./DESIGN.md#words-are-part-of-the-interface)                                      | SHOULD | Remove copy with no new decision, constraint or consequence; do not replace it with a decorative badge or tooltip.                                                                                                                                                                                                  |                 |
| [D-COPY-9](./DESIGN.md#words-are-part-of-the-interface)                                      | MUST   | Preserve accessible names, field labels, units, errors and risk disclosures.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | browser         |
| [D-COPY-10](./DESIGN.md#words-are-part-of-the-interface)                                     | SHOULD | Preserve useful first-use guidance, and test whether the task remains understandable.                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |                 |
| [D-COPY-11](./DESIGN.md#words-are-part-of-the-interface)                                     | SHOULD | Let context carry context: `Users` rather than `User Management`; do not repeat a dialog's question in its body.                                                                                                                                                                                                    |                 |
| [D-COPY-12](./DESIGN.md#words-are-part-of-the-interface)                                     | SHOULD | Name results (`Save`, `Move`, `Delete`), not gestures (`Click to save`). Include the object only when context does not establish it.                                                                                                                                                                                |                 |
| [D-COPY-13](./DESIGN.md#words-are-part-of-the-interface)                                     | MUST   | `Cancel` leaves without committing.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | browser         |
| [D-COPY-14](./DESIGN.md#words-are-part-of-the-interface)                                     | SHOULD | Use sentence case, no period on short labels, and a period on explanatory sentences.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |                 |
| [D-COPY-15](./DESIGN.md#words-are-part-of-the-interface)                                     | SHOULD | Use one `…` when an action needs more input before completing; reserve ALL CAPS for short statuses, eyebrows and acronyms.                                                                                                                                                                                          |                 |
| [D-REVIEW-1](./DESIGN.md#review-checklist-for-a-composed-surface)                            | SHOULD | Apply these questions to the affected surface and reachable changed states. Skip irrelevant variants; a small patch does not require redesigning unrelated pages. A "no" within scope is a finding.                                                                                                                 |                 |
| [D-REVIEW-2](./DESIGN.md#review-checklist-for-a-composed-surface)                            | SHOULD | Follow [ACCEPTANCE](./ACCEPTANCE.md) for independent expectations, actual runtime/capture identity, browser measurements and separate automated, agent and human results.                                                                                                                                           |                 |
| [D-IA-1](./DESIGN.md#10-information-architecture--the-shape-before-the-composition)          | SHOULD | Choose structure before composition for information-dense consoles, dashboards and workbenches.                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |                 |
| [D-IA-2](./DESIGN.md#10-information-architecture--the-shape-before-the-composition)          | SHOULD | Give single-conversion and landing pages their own task structure rather than a dense-console template.                                                                                                                                                                                                             |                 |
| [D-IA-3](./DESIGN.md#answer-three-questions-before-naming-a-component)                       | SHOULD | Settle all three answers before choosing components.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |                 |
| [D-IA-4](./DESIGN.md#answer-three-questions-before-naming-a-component)                       | SHOULD | **A page has exactly one primary model.** Supporting models may help the reader understand or operate it; they may not compete for the first screen.                                                                                                                                                                |                 |
| [D-IA-5](./DESIGN.md#answer-three-questions-before-naming-a-component)                       | SHOULD | Prefer a clear, unambiguous next choice over an arbitrary click budget. Test whether readers recognize the next action, not merely whether the destination is reachable.                                                                                                                                            |                 |
| [D-IA-6](./DESIGN.md#the-shape-follows-the-task-not-the-payload)                             | SHOULD | Choose a skeleton from the reader's question, not an API array or route ID, using the table below.                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |                 |
| [D-IA-7](./DESIGN.md#the-shape-follows-the-task-not-the-payload)                             | SHOULD | Do not confuse historical events with future steps, a filter with kanban, or ordered prose with a field grid. A date alone does not justify a calendar.                                                                                                                                                             |                 |
| [D-IA-8](./DESIGN.md#the-shape-follows-the-task-not-the-payload)                             | SHOULD | Ship multiple views only when each serves a distinct task worth its filter/state/action maintenance.                                                                                                                                                                                                                |                 |
| [D-IA-9](./DESIGN.md#each-kind-of-information-has-a-place)                                   | SHOULD | Lead with identity and status in the title or summary region, and keep actions, feedback and evidence beside their subject, as the table below lays out.                                                                                                                                                            |                 |
| [D-IA-10](./DESIGN.md#each-kind-of-information-has-a-place)                                  | SHOULD | **Every fact has exactly one authoritative location.** Elsewhere shows a summary or an entry point that links back to it.                                                                                                                                                                                           |                 |
| [D-IA-11](./DESIGN.md#each-kind-of-information-has-a-place)                                  | SHOULD | Follow the default reading order: page identity → current status or exception → primary task and primary action → the information the judgement needs → relationships, changes, evidence → secondary information and low-frequency actions.                                                                         |                 |
| [D-IA-12](./DESIGN.md#each-kind-of-information-has-a-place)                                  | SHOULD | **One primary action per task region**, and it is the most likely next step, not the most destructive one (§9, "Emphasis is a budget", governs how much weight it may take).                                                                                                                                        |                 |
| [D-IA-13](./DESIGN.md#density-is-effective-information-not-controls-per-inch)                | SHOULD | **Use at most two adjacent density levels on one page**: spacious for first use and risky confirmation, standard for most lists and details, compact for expert workbenches.                                                                                                                                        |                 |
| [D-IA-14](./DESIGN.md#density-is-effective-information-not-controls-per-inch)                | MAY    | Container padding and line height may tighten.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |                 |
| [D-IA-15](./DESIGN.md#density-is-effective-information-not-controls-per-inch)                | MUST   | Readable body text, a visible focus ring and pointer target size do not shrink with density (§7, §8).                                                                                                                                                                                                               | browser         |
| [D-IA-16](./DESIGN.md#containers-do-not-fix-structure)                                       | SHOULD | **One contextual return per view.** Do not show an outer “Back to chat” and an inner “Back to artifacts” together.                                                                                                                                                                                                  |                 |
| [D-IA-17](./DESIGN.md#containers-do-not-fix-structure)                                       | SHOULD | The detail view returns to its immediate parent.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |                 |
