| [D-IA-18](./DESIGN.md#containers-do-not-fix-structure)                                       | MUST   | Ancestors remain reachable through the route hierarchy or clearly named breadcrumbs.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | browser         |
| [D-IA-19](./DESIGN.md#containers-do-not-fix-structure)                                       | SHOULD | Verify the full journey, including focus return and long translated destination names.                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |                 |
| [D-IA-27](./DESIGN.md#containers-do-not-fix-structure)                                       | MUST   | Returning to the parent restores focus to the originating item.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | browser         |
| [D-IA-20](./DESIGN.md#containers-do-not-fix-structure)                                       | MUST   | If text does not fit, reflow or use a meaningful shorter destination; an ellipsis or tooltip never hides the only destination cue.                                                                                                                                                                                  | browser         |
| [D-IA-21](./DESIGN.md#containers-do-not-fix-structure)                                       | SHOULD | Choose one composition for the parent context. Do not add a breadcrumb merely to relabel a redundant return shortcut, or repeat that parent as an inert crumb above its return command.                                                                                                                             |                 |
| [D-IA-22](./DESIGN.md#containers-do-not-fix-structure)                                       | SHOULD | Use breadcrumbs when the hierarchy itself helps the task.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |                 |
| [D-IA-23](./DESIGN.md#containers-do-not-fix-structure)                                       | SHOULD | Give a route to anything needing a copyable link, history, a side-by-side comparison, or work that survives a refresh.                                                                                                                                                                                              |                 |
| [D-IA-24](./DESIGN.md#containers-do-not-fix-structure)                                       | SHOULD | Reserve a modal for a short confirmation or a single field, a popover or menu for transient context, and a disclosure row for progressive disclosure.                                                                                                                                                               |                 |
| [D-IA-25](./DESIGN.md#containers-do-not-fix-structure)                                       | SHOULD | **Tabs carry peer views of one object** — its conversation, its checks, its diff — never unrelated modules; that is navigation's job.                                                                                                                                                                               |                 |
| [D-IA-26](./DESIGN.md#containers-do-not-fix-structure)                                       | SHOULD | If the chosen library lacks a suitable primitive, use existing semantic elements and host tokens; verify the required interaction rather than inventing unsupported APIs.                                                                                                                                           |                 |
| [D-VERIFY-1](./DESIGN.md#verification-checklist-before-shipping-ui)                          | SHOULD | Select checks for the affected surface, supported variants and changed behavior; do not create unrelated flows merely to satisfy the list.                                                                                                                                                                          |                 |
| [D-VERIFY-2](./DESIGN.md#verification-checklist-before-shipping-ui)                          | SHOULD | Primary task and primary action are unmistakable.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |                 |
| [D-VERIFY-5](./DESIGN.md#verification-checklist-before-shipping-ui)                          | SHOULD | Exercise all changed **states** (hover, active, focus, disabled, loading, empty, error).                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |                 |
| [D-VERIFY-7](./DESIGN.md#verification-checklist-before-shipping-ui)                          | SHOULD | Cover relevant edge cases: long text, large numbers and the host's supported scripts/locales.                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |                 |
| [D-VERIFY-8](./DESIGN.md#verification-checklist-before-shipping-ui)                          | SHOULD | Spacing comes from the scale; type uses a role; color uses semantic tokens.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |                 |
| [D-VERIFY-9](./DESIGN.md#verification-checklist-before-shipping-ui)                          | SHOULD | Run the host’s applicable checks and inspect actual browser evidence.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |                 |
| [D-VERIFY-10](./DESIGN.md#verification-checklist-before-shipping-ui)                         | SHOULD | Copy follows §6.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |                 |
| [D-VERIFY-12](./DESIGN.md#verification-checklist-before-shipping-ui)                         | SHOULD | For a dense surface: one primary model, the skeleton chosen from the question rather than the payload, and every fact with one authoritative location (§10).                                                                                                                                                        |                 |
| [X-INPUT-1](./INTERACTION.md#1-inputs-drafts-and-intent)                                     | MUST   | Keep labels, prerequisites and validation messages near the field they affect.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | browser         |
| [X-INPUT-2](./INTERACTION.md#1-inputs-drafts-and-intent)                                     | SHOULD | Distinguish a missing value from an unavailable service, and explain why submission is unavailable when the prerequisite is not obvious.                                                                                                                                                                            |                 |
| [X-INPUT-3](./INTERACTION.md#1-inputs-drafts-and-intent)                                     | SHOULD | Use the appropriate native input semantics and autocomplete, and preserve platform editing conventions; expose keyboard shortcuts where they help.                                                                                                                                                                  |                 |
| [X-INPUT-4](./INTERACTION.md#1-inputs-drafts-and-intent)                                     | MUST   | Submit dispatches once per activation, and Restore only repopulates fields without submitting them.                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | unit            |
| [X-INPUT-5](./INTERACTION.md#1-inputs-drafts-and-intent)                                     | SHOULD | Follow the remaining rows of the input transition table.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |                 |
| [X-INPUT-6](./INTERACTION.md#1-inputs-drafts-and-intent)                                     | MUST   | Enter submits only where the field's documented convention calls for it, and never during IME composition (check `isComposing`). Multiline entry keeps working.                                                                                                                                                     | browser         |
| [X-INPUT-7](./INTERACTION.md#1-inputs-drafts-and-intent)                                     | MUST   | Dictation updates text and never submits by itself; the text that preceded the capture is retained.                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | browser         |
| [X-INPUT-8](./INTERACTION.md#1-inputs-drafts-and-intent)                                     | MUST   | Do not rebuild a focused input on a search response, stream update, resize or status change.                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | browser         |
| [X-INPUT-9](./INTERACTION.md#1-inputs-drafts-and-intent)                                     | MUST   | The latest intent wins: an older query never replaces newer results, and a preview for one file never appears under another.                                                                                                                                                                                        | unit            |
| [X-INPUT-10](./INTERACTION.md#1-inputs-drafts-and-intent)                                    | SHOULD | Implement X-INPUT-9 with the host’s async identity and cancellation mechanisms; ranui contributors can consult [CODING §3](./CODING.md#3-state-and-ownership).                                                                                                                                                      |                 |
| [X-INPUT-11](./INTERACTION.md#1-inputs-drafts-and-intent)                                    | MUST   | Promise persistence only after it succeeds; a retained draft is not a saved one.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | unit            |
| [X-INPUT-12](./INTERACTION.md#1-inputs-drafts-and-intent)                                    | MUST   | Highlight search matches with safe text nodes or equivalent escaping, never by inserting the query as HTML.                                                                                                                                                                                                         | unit            |
| [X-INPUT-13](./INTERACTION.md#1-inputs-drafts-and-intent)                                    | SHOULD | Keep enough text around a highlighted match to explain why the item matched.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |                 |
| [X-FOCUS-1](./INTERACTION.md#2-reachable-controls-and-predictable-focus)                     | SHOULD | Build controls from native semantics and supported component contracts.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |                 |
| [X-FOCUS-2](./INTERACTION.md#2-reachable-controls-and-predictable-focus)                     | MUST   | Every icon-only action has an accessible name.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | browser         |
| [X-FOCUS-3](./INTERACTION.md#2-reachable-controls-and-predictable-focus)                     | MUST   | A secondary action revealed on hover is also revealed on keyboard focus and has a persistent tap route on coarse input.                                                                                                                                                                                             | browser         |
| [X-FOCUS-4](./INTERACTION.md#2-reachable-controls-and-predictable-focus)                     | SHOULD | Keep essential recovery actions visible rather than revealed on hover.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |                 |
| [X-FOCUS-5](./INTERACTION.md#2-reachable-controls-and-predictable-focus)                     | MUST   | Disabled controls stay quiet on hover and cannot dispatch.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | browser         |
| [X-FOCUS-6](./INTERACTION.md#2-reachable-controls-and-predictable-focus)                     | MUST   | The target box and focus ring keep their size and position while a label or status changes.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | browser         |
| [X-FOCUS-7](./INTERACTION.md#2-reachable-controls-and-predictable-focus)                     | MUST   | Integrate through public attributes, events, slots, variables and parts; do not patch private shadow roots.                                                                                                                                                                                                         | review          |
| [X-FOCUS-8](./INTERACTION.md#2-reachable-controls-and-predictable-focus)                     | MUST   | Do not add host tab stops that lead nowhere or duplicate an inner control.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | browser         |
| [X-FOCUS-9](./INTERACTION.md#2-reachable-controls-and-predictable-focus)                     | MUST   | A composed dialog places initial focus inside itself, keeps Tab and Shift+Tab within it, closes on Escape and Cancel, activates its default action on Enter, and returns focus to the opener when it closes.                                                                                                        | browser         |
| [X-FOCUS-10](./INTERACTION.md#2-reachable-controls-and-predictable-focus)                    | SHOULD | When a focus trap cannot reach a control (for example a closed-shadow button in a footer), fix the supported integration or place native buttons in its supported slot.                                                                                                                                             |                 |
| [X-FOCUS-11](./INTERACTION.md#2-reachable-controls-and-predictable-focus)                    | MUST   | A collapsed region still identifies its contents and state, and disclosure never hides an unresolved actionable error.                                                                                                                                                                                              | browser         |
| [X-FOCUS-12](./INTERACTION.md#2-reachable-controls-and-predictable-focus)                    | MUST   | Collapsing a region that contains focus returns focus to its toggle; removing the focused object moves focus to the next meaningful action or a stable parent control.                                                                                                                                              | browser         |
| [X-FOCUS-13](./INTERACTION.md#2-reachable-controls-and-predictable-focus)                    | MUST   | Do not move focus merely because a background request completed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | browser         |
| [X-FOCUS-14](./INTERACTION.md#2-reachable-controls-and-predictable-focus)                    | SHOULD | Write the collapsed summary to help readers decide whether to expand; when the expanded body already shows that content, omit the repeated summary and keep the title and state.                                                                                                                                    |                 |
| [X-FEEDBACK-1](./INTERACTION.md#3-feedback-and-reading-position)                             | SHOULD | Show feedback next to the object acted on. A “Copied” acknowledgment beside Copy is easier to associate than an unrelated global notification; a toast suits changes beyond the current object or feedback that would otherwise go unnoticed.                                                                       |                 |
| [X-FEEDBACK-2](./INTERACTION.md#3-feedback-and-reading-position)                             | MUST   | Show a success acknowledgment only after the operation succeeded (for Copy, after clipboard success), and handle rejection locally while keeping button geometry and focus.                                                                                                                                         | browser         |
| [X-FEEDBACK-3](./INTERACTION.md#3-feedback-and-reading-position)                             | MUST   | Async feedback belongs to the operation's source snapshot: when content changes while Copy is pending, the older completion never marks the new content “Copied”, and stale feedback is cleared or identified as stale.                                                                                             | unit, browser   |
| [X-FEEDBACK-4](./INTERACTION.md#3-feedback-and-reading-position)                             | MUST   | Do not announce every streamed character to assistive technology.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | browser         |
| [X-FEEDBACK-5](./INTERACTION.md#3-feedback-and-reading-position)                             | MUST   | Live logs and streaming results follow only while the reader is at the latest content; scrolling away suspends following, and “Jump to latest” restores it without stealing the reading position.                                                                                                                   | recording       |
| [X-FEEDBACK-6](./INTERACTION.md#3-feedback-and-reading-position)                             | SHOULD | Use a supported follow/pin contract from the host or chosen component, and keep job and persistence state in the application; an append-only reading log is not a job manager.                                                                                                                                      |                 |
| [X-RECOVER-1](./INTERACTION.md#4-progress-failure-and-recovery)                              | SHOULD | Name a known phase (“Reading files”, “Checking permissions”, “Writing export”) rather than showing only a spinner, and announce meaningful phase changes, not every timer tick.                                                                                                                                     |                 |
| [X-RECOVER-2](./INTERACTION.md#4-progress-failure-and-recovery)                              | MUST   | Show a percentage only with a measurable denominator; elapsed time is secondary and never presented as a completion estimate.                                                                                                                                                                                       | review          |
| [X-RECOVER-3](./INTERACTION.md#4-progress-failure-and-recovery)                              | MUST   | An error answers what failed, whether anything changed, and what to do next, and promises only what the host can establish.                                                                                                                                                                                         | review          |
| [X-RECOVER-4](./INTERACTION.md#4-progress-failure-and-recovery)                              | MUST   | Preserve in-memory input when storage fails, and report the persistence failure separately.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | unit            |
| [X-RECOVER-5](./INTERACTION.md#4-progress-failure-and-recovery)                              | SHOULD | Put credential-free diagnostics in optional details.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |                 |
| [X-RECOVER-6](./INTERACTION.md#4-progress-failure-and-recovery)                              | SHOULD | Give one failure one coherent recovery, not duplicate rows and toasts.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |                 |
| [X-RECOVER-7](./INTERACTION.md#4-progress-failure-and-recovery)                              | MUST   | A timeout does not prove rollback: establish whether a mutating operation committed before retrying, using the host's idempotency or deduplication contract where available.                                                                                                                                        | unit            |
| [X-CANCEL-1](./INTERACTION.md#5-cancel-retry-and-completion-are-different-outcomes)          | MUST   | Keep Cancel and Submit independently reachable when both are supported, with clear accessible names and stable positions.                                                                                                                                                                                           | browser         |
| [X-CANCEL-2](./INTERACTION.md#5-cancel-retry-and-completion-are-different-outcomes)          | MUST   | A cancellation request is not an acknowledged cancellation: show its pending state until confirmed, and when the client can only stop waiting, say so instead of claiming the job stopped.                                                                                                                          | unit            |
| [X-CANCEL-3](./INTERACTION.md#5-cancel-retry-and-completion-are-different-outcomes)          | MUST   | Cancellation is not shown as failure.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | browser         |
| [X-CANCEL-4](./INTERACTION.md#5-cancel-retry-and-completion-are-different-outcomes)          | MUST   | Retry dispatches work again without silently broadening scope or switching destinations; Restore only repopulates editable inputs.                                                                                                                                                                                  | unit            |
| [X-CANCEL-5](./INTERACTION.md#5-cancel-retry-and-completion-are-different-outcomes)          | MUST   | Report saved or applied success only after the write is confirmed, and retain recoverable partial output.                                                                                                                                                                                                           | unit            |
| [X-CANCEL-6](./INTERACTION.md#5-cancel-retry-and-completion-are-different-outcomes)          | MUST   | Offer Undo only when the host can actually reverse the operation, and never promise that Cancel undoes a completed write.                                                                                                                                                                                           | review          |
| [X-VERIFY-1](./INTERACTION.md#6-verify-what-a-person-can-observe)                            | SHOULD | Choose evidence by the defect, using the layers below, rather than running every possible test for a small change.                                                                                                                                                                                                  |                 |
| [X-VERIFY-2](./INTERACTION.md#6-verify-what-a-person-can-observe)                            | SHOULD | Include offline and failure paths when the task depends on external work.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |                 |
| [X-VERIFY-3](./INTERACTION.md#6-verify-what-a-person-can-observe)                            | SHOULD | Report the tested commit and any remaining external prerequisites.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |                 |
| [V-AGREE-1](./ACCEPTANCE.md#agree-on-the-observable-result)                                  | SHOULD | Before editing, settle the [design brief](./DESIGN.md#style-coherence-across-components-and-pages), and state the affected task, views/states and independent expectations in that same note.                                                                                                                       |                 |
| [V-AGREE-2](./ACCEPTANCE.md#agree-on-the-observable-result)                                  | SHOULD | Name the relevant owner, supported public API and host capability limits.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |                 |
| [V-AGREE-3](./ACCEPTANCE.md#agree-on-the-observable-result)                                  | SHOULD | Select widths, themes, languages and input paths from the actual change, without inventing unrelated work.                                                                                                                                                                                                          |                 |
| [V-AGREE-4](./ACCEPTANCE.md#agree-on-the-observable-result)                                  | SHOULD | For composition, state content/text/icon spines, intentional navigation columns, hit bounds and vertical relationships.                                                                                                                                                                                             |                 |
| [V-AGREE-5](./ACCEPTANCE.md#agree-on-the-observable-result)                                  | MUST   | Do not derive the expected value from the implementation under test.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | review          |
| [V-AGREE-6](./ACCEPTANCE.md#agree-on-the-observable-result)                                  | SHOULD | Review in order: task/hierarchy, static composition, reachable combined states, then motion.                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |                 |
| [V-AGREE-7](./ACCEPTANCE.md#agree-on-the-observable-result)                                  | SHOULD | Do not add animation to compensate for unresolved proportions or unclear navigation.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |                 |
| [V-AGREE-8](./ACCEPTANCE.md#agree-on-the-observable-result)                                  | SHOULD | When a review changes the intended design, update the existing brief first and identify the evidence that prompted it.                                                                                                                                                                                              |                 |
| [V-AGREE-9](./ACCEPTANCE.md#agree-on-the-observable-result)                                  | SHOULD | Keep one rule owner.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |                 |
| [V-AGREE-10](./ACCEPTANCE.md#agree-on-the-observable-result)                                 | MUST   | Do not let one kind of check substitute for another: an API/token check, an image comparison and an agent run each establish only their own result.                                                                                                                                                                 | review          |
| [V-AGREE-11](./ACCEPTANCE.md#agree-on-the-observable-result)                                 | MUST   | A fixture demonstrates its own result, not acceptance of a host application it did not render; do not claim it as host acceptance.                                                                                                                                                                                  | review          |
| [V-PROOF-1](./ACCEPTANCE.md#browser-proof)                                                   | MUST   | When reproducing a visible defect, capture the actual running surface before the fix.                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | browser         |
| [V-PROOF-2](./ACCEPTANCE.md#browser-proof)                                                   | MUST   | After the fix, capture the same relevant state and inspect the full pane with realistic copy and surrounding chrome.                                                                                                                                                                                                | browser         |
| [V-PROOF-3](./ACCEPTANCE.md#browser-proof)                                                   | MUST   | Do not offer a mockup, source diff, changed assertion or screenshot of an unrelated build as proof.                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | review          |
| [V-PROOF-4](./ACCEPTANCE.md#browser-proof)                                                   | SHOULD | Inspect the composition as well as the link count: relabeling a redundant return as a breadcrumb can still repeat the same context and add an unnecessary header row.                                                                                                                                               |                 |
| [V-PROOF-5](./ACCEPTANCE.md#browser-proof)                                                   | SHOULD | Trace ancestor reachability through the parent before deciding another visible shortcut is needed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |                 |
| [V-PROOF-6](./ACCEPTANCE.md#browser-proof)                                                   | MUST   | Wait for component registration, pending content, fonts and rendered frames before measuring.                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | browser         |
| [V-PROOF-7](./ACCEPTANCE.md#browser-proof)                                                   | MUST   | Fail on missing or zero-sized targets.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | browser         |
| [V-PROOF-8](./ACCEPTANCE.md#browser-proof)                                                   | MUST   | Record any subpixel tolerance, and keep it below a full CSS pixel for exact spines (the source example uses 0.5px).                                                                                                                                                                                                 | review          |
| [V-PROOF-9](./ACCEPTANCE.md#browser-proof)                                                   | MUST   | For live overlays, verify that capture preserves the viewport and includes the full trigger/panel; a full-page screenshot can invalidate a crop by causing responsive reflow or portal repositioning.                                                                                                               | browser         |
| [V-PROOF-10](./ACCEPTANCE.md#browser-proof)                                                  | MUST   | Measure the defect's layer: wrapper, inner content, rendered text Range, icon viewport and actual pointer target are different. A Range is not exact glyph ink.                                                                                                                                                     | browser         |
| [V-PROOF-11](./ACCEPTANCE.md#browser-proof)                                                  | MUST   | Account for shadow parts through supported test seams; do not introduce production shadow queries for acceptance.                                                                                                                                                                                                   | review          |
| [V-PROOF-12](./ACCEPTANCE.md#browser-proof)                                                  | SHOULD | Exercise affected reflow, wrapped translations, optional content and input paths.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |                 |
| [V-PROOF-13](./ACCEPTANCE.md#browser-proof)                                                  | MUST   | Do not use a static screenshot as proof of focus return, keyboard navigation, touch discovery, interruptibility or async settlement.                                                                                                                                                                                | review          |
| [V-PROOF-14](./ACCEPTANCE.md#browser-proof)                                                  | MUST   | Record a continuous interaction when the defect unfolds over time.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | recording       |
| [V-PROOF-15](./ACCEPTANCE.md#browser-proof)                                                  | MUST   | For a layout assertion, prove it rejects the relevant defect: move only label text while the frame stays fixed, introduce a doubled margin/phantom helper, or expand a title target into filler.                                                                                                                    | browser         |
| [V-PROOF-16](./ACCEPTANCE.md#browser-proof)                                                  | MUST   | Confirm the mutation won the cascade, observe failure, restore and observe success.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | browser         |
| [V-PROOF-17](./ACCEPTANCE.md#browser-proof)                                                  | SHOULD | Use mutations relevant to the task rather than repeating the entire example suite for a tiny fix.                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |                 |
| [V-PROOF-18](./ACCEPTANCE.md#browser-proof)                                                  | MUST   | Verify raw data when changing presentation.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | browser, unit   |
| [V-PROOF-19](./ACCEPTANCE.md#browser-proof)                                                  | MUST   | For code, copy the source payload, not highlighted DOM text: preserve tabs, blank lines, final newline and streamed additions.                                                                                                                                                                                      | unit            |
| [V-PROOF-20](./ACCEPTANCE.md#browser-proof)                                                  | MUST   | Verify clipboard success/failure, native selection and long-line scrolling independently.                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | browser         |
| [V-PROOF-21](./ACCEPTANCE.md#browser-proof)                                                  | MUST   | Document browser selection normalization without allowing it to alter the raw clipboard payload.                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | unit, review    |
| [V-PROOF-22](./ACCEPTANCE.md#browser-proof)                                                  | MUST   | Do not claim native browser zoom or text-size accessibility support from CSS zoom stress.                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | review          |
| [V-PROOF-23](./ACCEPTANCE.md#browser-proof)                                                  | MUST   | Say which paths remain unverified.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | review          |
| [V-MOTION-1](./ACCEPTANCE.md#review-motion-over-time)                                        | MUST   | For changed motion, inspect a continuous action at normal speed, then replay slowly where a transition breaks.                                                                                                                                                                                                      | recording       |
| [V-MOTION-2](./ACCEPTANCE.md#review-motion-over-time)                                        | MUST   | Include activation, intermediate state, completion and the reverse path; repeat or reverse input before completion.                                                                                                                                                                                                 | recording       |
| [V-MOTION-3](./ACCEPTANCE.md#review-motion-over-time)                                        | MUST   | Verify the final state, focus, event count and reading position independently of the animation.                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | browser         |
| [V-MOTION-4](./ACCEPTANCE.md#review-motion-over-time)                                        | MUST   | Use a slow replay to diagnose discontinuity, not as a frame-rate benchmark.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | review          |
| [V-MOTION-5](./ACCEPTANCE.md#review-motion-over-time)                                        | MUST   | Give reduced motion its own visible-state check, not just a shorter recording.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | browser         |
| [V-MOTION-6](./ACCEPTANCE.md#review-motion-over-time)                                        | SHOULD | Report a temporal defect as `element → input → observed frame/state → expected continuity`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |                 |
| [V-MOTION-7](./ACCEPTANCE.md#review-motion-over-time)                                        | SHOULD | Use one representative real task across affected siblings to detect inconsistent motion language.                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |                 |
| [V-MOTION-8](./ACCEPTANCE.md#review-motion-over-time)                                        | SHOULD | Check the full composition again after local fixes.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |                 |
| [V-MOTION-9](./ACCEPTANCE.md#review-motion-over-time)                                        | SHOULD | Preserve failed iterations as diagnostics, separate from accepted captures.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |                 |
| [V-WALK-1](./ACCEPTANCE.md#walk-through-the-task)                                            | SHOULD | For a changed workflow or composition, start with a realistic goal expressed without naming the control to use.                                                                                                                                                                                                     |                 |
| [V-WALK-2](./ACCEPTANCE.md#walk-through-the-task)                                            | SHOULD | Complete the goal from the actual entry point through result, recovery and return, as relevant.                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |                 |
| [V-WALK-3](./ACCEPTANCE.md#walk-through-the-task)                                            | SHOULD | Record the first choice, any ambiguous label, hesitation or backtracking, and whether the result makes the next step clear.                                                                                                                                                                                         |                 |
| [V-WALK-4](./ACCEPTANCE.md#walk-through-the-task)                                            | SHOULD | Use realistic content, including a representative long or failing case, rather than a polished empty state alone.                                                                                                                                                                                                   |                 |
| [V-WALK-5](./ACCEPTANCE.md#walk-through-the-task)                                            | SHOULD | Fix task structure and content hierarchy before adding decorative effects.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |                 |
| [V-WALK-6](./ACCEPTANCE.md#walk-through-the-task)                                            | SHOULD | Report the most consequential observed problems (up to three), with the state and evidence that show each one.                                                                                                                                                                                                      |                 |
| [V-WALK-7](./ACCEPTANCE.md#walk-through-the-task)                                            | MUST   | Do not invent findings to fill a quota.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | review          |
| [V-WALK-8](./ACCEPTANCE.md#walk-through-the-task)                                            | SHOULD | Repeat the affected path after correction.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |                 |
| [V-WALK-9](./ACCEPTANCE.md#walk-through-the-task)                                            | MUST   | Report an agent walkthrough as a defect search, not as a human usability study.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | review          |
| [V-WALK-10](./ACCEPTANCE.md#walk-through-the-task)                                           | SHOULD | When observing a real participant, let them attempt the goal before explaining the interface, and preserve that distinction in the results below.                                                                                                                                                                   |                 |
| [V-FRESH-1](./ACCEPTANCE.md#bind-evidence-to-what-actually-ran)                              | MUST   | Runtime: record the tested source revision/build and relevant dirty inputs or their fingerprint, including shared styles/components and incoming data when they affect the result. A Git HEAD alone is insufficient if the running build or working tree differs.                                                   | review          |
| [V-FRESH-2](./ACCEPTANCE.md#bind-evidence-to-what-actually-ran)                              | MUST   | Scope/environment: record affected view/group membership, route/state, viewport, theme, locale, browser and input or reduced-motion settings where relevant.                                                                                                                                                        | review          |
| [V-FRESH-3](./ACCEPTANCE.md#bind-evidence-to-what-actually-ran)                              | MUST   | Media: record capture/recording locations and content identity (for example SHA-256), tied to that runtime and state.                                                                                                                                                                                               | review          |
| [V-FRESH-4](./ACCEPTANCE.md#bind-evidence-to-what-actually-ran)                              | MUST   | Keep before and after distinct; never overwrite the only before image.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | review          |
| [V-FRESH-5](./ACCEPTANCE.md#bind-evidence-to-what-actually-ran)                              | MUST   | Review: record what the automated check and agent inspection actually established, separate from any human decision and any unverified state.                                                                                                                                                                       | review          |
| [V-FRESH-6](./ACCEPTANCE.md#bind-evidence-to-what-actually-ran)                              | MAY    | Use a short Markdown record; an existing manifest may supply these fields.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |                 |
| [V-FRESH-7](./ACCEPTANCE.md#bind-evidence-to-what-actually-ran)                              | SHOULD | Do not add a new evidence service or configuration framework for an ordinary change.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |                 |
| [V-FRESH-8](./ACCEPTANCE.md#bind-evidence-to-what-actually-ran)                              | MUST   | Keep hashes beside the files or in a referenced manifest so the claimed binding can be checked independently.                                                                                                                                                                                                       | review          |
| [V-FRESH-9](./ACCEPTANCE.md#bind-evidence-to-what-actually-ran)                              | MUST   | Treat the affected review as stale after replacing an image, editing a recording, changing group membership or changing relevant runtime inputs.                                                                                                                                                                    | review          |
| [V-FRESH-10](./ACCEPTANCE.md#bind-evidence-to-what-actually-ran)                             | MUST   | After a shared style/component change, refresh every affected state, rebuild if needed, then inspect the new evidence.                                                                                                                                                                                              | browser, review |
| [V-FRESH-11](./ACCEPTANCE.md#bind-evidence-to-what-actually-ran)                             | MUST   | Present no old capture as current proof.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | review          |
| [V-FRESH-12](./ACCEPTANCE.md#bind-evidence-to-what-actually-ran)                             | MUST   | When keeping runtime evidence across a docs-only edit or unrelated source change, record why its dependency scope is unaffected.                                                                                                                                                                                    | review          |
| [V-REPORT-1](./ACCEPTANCE.md#report-authority-truthfully)                                    | MUST   | Keep these three results separate, even in a one-paragraph report.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | review          |
| [V-REPORT-2](./ACCEPTANCE.md#report-authority-truthfully)                                    | MUST   | Claim each result only from the source the table above names, and never for what the table says it does not establish.                                                                                                                                                                                              | review          |
| [V-REPORT-3](./ACCEPTANCE.md#report-authority-truthfully)                                    | SHOULD | Use explicit outcomes such as `automated: passed`, `agent review: passed with limits`, `human: not requested`.                                                                                                                                                                                                      |                 |
| [V-REPORT-4](./ACCEPTANCE.md#report-authority-truthfully)                                    | MUST   | If human review was requested and is outstanding, say `pending`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | review          |
| [V-REPORT-5](./ACCEPTANCE.md#report-authority-truthfully)                                    | MUST   | If a user rejected it, preserve `rejected` and the finding until that user reviews the updated scope.                                                                                                                                                                                                               | review          |
| [V-REPORT-6](./ACCEPTANCE.md#report-authority-truthfully)                                    | MUST   | An agent may report its correction and fresh checks, but never invents a user decision or clears a human rejection.                                                                                                                                                                                                 | review          |
| [V-REPORT-7](./ACCEPTANCE.md#report-authority-truthfully)                                    | MUST   | Avoid an unattributed “accepted”, “approved” or “验收通过”.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | review          |
| [V-REPORT-8](./ACCEPTANCE.md#report-authority-truthfully)                                    | SHOULD | Finish and deliver authorized work while reporting `not requested`/`pending` truthfully.                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |                 |
| [V-REPORT-9](./ACCEPTANCE.md#report-authority-truthfully)                                    | SHOULD | Ask only when the actual authorization or a necessary product decision is missing.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |                 |
| [V-REPORT-10](./ACCEPTANCE.md#report-authority-truthfully)                                   | MUST   | Never label the agent's own visual check “user accepted”.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | review          |
| [V-EVAL-1](./ACCEPTANCE.md#regression-of-the-guidance-itself)                                | SHOULD | For opt-in or task-authorized live evaluation of skill/routing/acceptance changes, use the source-only [six agent scenarios](https://github.com/chaxus/ran/tree/main/plugins/ran/evals).                                                                                                                            |                 |
| [V-EVAL-2](./ACCEPTANCE.md#regression-of-the-guidance-itself)                                | MUST   | Freeze tasks, fixtures, tools and independent rubrics before live runs.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | review          |
| [V-EVAL-3](./ACCEPTANCE.md#regression-of-the-guidance-itself)                                | MUST   | Use fresh sessions with matching model/settings.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | review          |
| [V-EVAL-4](./ACCEPTANCE.md#regression-of-the-guidance-itself)                                | MUST   | Pin baseline and candidate guidance in separate workspaces.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | review          |
| [V-EVAL-5](./ACCEPTANCE.md#regression-of-the-guidance-itself)                                | MUST   | Retain actual agent work, prompts, outcome checks and evidence.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | review          |
| [V-EVAL-6](./ACCEPTANCE.md#regression-of-the-guidance-itself)                                | MUST   | Record baseline passes as controls and candidate failures as failures.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | review          |
| [V-EVAL-7](./ACCEPTANCE.md#regression-of-the-guidance-itself)                                | MUST   | Do not show workers the assessor's thresholds or repair patches.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | review          |
| [V-EVAL-8](./ACCEPTANCE.md#regression-of-the-guidance-itself)                                | MUST   | Claim behavior on those tasks only from live agent runs; prose matching, hand-authored answers or corrected test expectations are no evidence of it.                                                                                                                                                                | review          |
| [V-EVAL-9](./ACCEPTANCE.md#regression-of-the-guidance-itself)                                | MUST   | Inspect visual judgment independently of mechanical checks.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | review          |
| [V-EVAL-10](./ACCEPTANCE.md#regression-of-the-guidance-itself)                               | MUST   | Report sample size, tools and uncovered conditions.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | review          |
| [V-EVAL-11](./ACCEPTANCE.md#regression-of-the-guidance-itself)                               | MUST   | Six successful tasks are no proof of reliability across models; do not claim it from them.                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | review          |
| [W-RECIPE-1](./WORKFLOW_PATTERNS.md#optional-workflow-patterns)                              | SHOULD | For each selected recipe, establish what the application supports before choosing controls.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |                 |
| [W-RECIPE-2](./WORKFLOW_PATTERNS.md#optional-workflow-patterns)                              | SHOULD | Keep the state for jobs, configuration, selected sources and revisions in their existing owners. Views read that state and dispatch commands instead of duplicating service clients and request flags in each panel.                                                                                                |                 |
| [W-QUEUE-1](./WORKFLOW_PATTERNS.md#1-batch-work-and-queues)                                  | SHOULD | Settle the contract for each state in the queue table above.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |                 |
| [W-QUEUE-2](./WORKFLOW_PATTERNS.md#1-batch-work-and-queues)                                  | MUST   | New work never silently replaces or cancels the active job. Without queue support, retain the new input and explain the constraint.                                                                                                                                                                                 | unit            |
| [W-QUEUE-3](./WORKFLOW_PATTERNS.md#1-batch-work-and-queues)                                  | MUST   | Editing a pending item in a paused queue neither dispatches it nor resumes the queue.                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | unit            |
| [W-QUEUE-4](./WORKFLOW_PATTERNS.md#1-batch-work-and-queues)                                  | SHOULD | Summarize queued work in one line, such as “2 queued” or “Paused · 2 queued”.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |                 |
| [W-QUEUE-5](./WORKFLOW_PATTERNS.md#1-batch-work-and-queues)                                  | SHOULD | Collapse queue details when unneeded; expand into rows rather than nested cards.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |                 |
| [W-QUEUE-6](./WORKFLOW_PATTERNS.md#1-batch-work-and-queues)                                  | MUST   | Each row has an identifiable item and offers only supported actions: Edit, Remove, or Run now.                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | browser         |
| [W-QUEUE-7](./WORKFLOW_PATTERNS.md#1-batch-work-and-queues)                                  | SHOULD | Define whether Run now waits, preempts or runs concurrently.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |                 |
| [W-QUEUE-8](./WORKFLOW_PATTERNS.md#1-batch-work-and-queues)                                  | SHOULD | Represent preparation within the row instead of adding a large panel full of disabled commands.                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |                 |
| [W-QUEUE-9](./WORKFLOW_PATTERNS.md#1-batch-work-and-queues)                                  | MUST   | Queue editing preserves the current draft, and cancelling editing restores it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | unit            |
| [W-QUEUE-10](./WORKFLOW_PATTERNS.md#1-batch-work-and-queues)                                 | MUST   | Reconnection does not auto-dispatch queued work unless the user chose that policy.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | unit            |
| [W-QUEUE-11](./WORKFLOW_PATTERNS.md#1-batch-work-and-queues)                                 | SHOULD | Apply [general focus and cancel rules](./INTERACTION.md) when removing a row, collapsing the queue or stopping work.                                                                                                                                                                                                |                 |
| [W-SETTINGS-1](./WORKFLOW_PATTERNS.md#2-capability-aware-settings-and-offline-work)          | MUST   | Saving configuration and checking availability are separate actions with separate outcomes, and each shows what it accomplished.                                                                                                                                                                                    | unit, browser   |
| [W-SETTINGS-2](./WORKFLOW_PATTERNS.md#2-capability-aware-settings-and-offline-work)          | SHOULD | Derive controls from capability and state, not a single `connected` boolean.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |                 |
| [W-SETTINGS-3](./WORKFLOW_PATTERNS.md#2-capability-aware-settings-and-offline-work)          | SHOULD | Make each state in the settings table above distinguishable to the user.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |                 |
| [W-SETTINGS-4](./WORKFLOW_PATTERNS.md#2-capability-aware-settings-and-offline-work)          | MUST   | Reconnecting an account whose authorization is required or expired keeps saved work.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | unit            |
| [W-SETTINGS-5](./WORKFLOW_PATTERNS.md#2-capability-aware-settings-and-offline-work)          | MUST   | Invalidate verification when relevant endpoint, account or credential settings change.                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | unit            |
| [W-SETTINGS-6](./WORKFLOW_PATTERNS.md#2-capability-aware-settings-and-offline-work)          | SHOULD | Treat browser online/offline events as hints, not as proof that a particular endpoint works.                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |                 |
| [W-SETTINGS-7](./WORKFLOW_PATTERNS.md#2-capability-aware-settings-and-offline-work)          | SHOULD | Reveal settings for the chosen path. A local conversion path may need cache/download/device controls; a remote path may need endpoint/account controls.                                                                                                                                                             |                 |
| [W-SETTINGS-8](./WORKFLOW_PATTERNS.md#2-capability-aware-settings-and-offline-work)          | MUST   | Hide irrelevant fields **and their stale status messages**.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | browser         |
| [W-SETTINGS-9](./WORKFLOW_PATTERNS.md#2-capability-aware-settings-and-offline-work)          | SHOULD | Settings headers, field groups, account rows and unavailable/empty states retain the named content and navigation spines from [DESIGN's alignment contract](./DESIGN.md#alignment-is-structure-not-polish).                                                                                                         |                 |
| [W-SETTINGS-10](./WORKFLOW_PATTERNS.md#2-capability-aware-settings-and-offline-work)         | SHOULD | Keep a title/menu command content-hugging; a separate track absorbs header filler.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |                 |
| [W-SETTINGS-11](./WORKFLOW_PATTERNS.md#2-capability-aware-settings-and-offline-work)         | SHOULD | Count nested panel and control padding through to visible labels before declaring regions aligned.                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |                 |
| [W-SETTINGS-12](./WORKFLOW_PATTERNS.md#2-capability-aware-settings-and-offline-work)         | MUST   | Switching modes preserves the other modes' configuration.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | unit            |
| [W-SETTINGS-13](./WORKFLOW_PATTERNS.md#2-capability-aware-settings-and-offline-work)         | SHOULD | Keep the route back to another mode discoverable.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |                 |
| [W-SETTINGS-14](./WORKFLOW_PATTERNS.md#2-capability-aware-settings-and-offline-work)         | SHOULD | Explain the data destination before disclosure.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |                 |
| [W-SETTINGS-15](./WORKFLOW_PATTERNS.md#2-capability-aware-settings-and-offline-work)         | MUST   | A configured API endpoint is not presented as an authorized account.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | review          |
| [W-SETTINGS-16](./WORKFLOW_PATTERNS.md#2-capability-aware-settings-and-offline-work)         | MUST   | Offline, retain saved content and drafts when their data and implementation are available.                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | unit, browser   |
| [W-SETTINGS-17](./WORKFLOW_PATTERNS.md#2-capability-aware-settings-and-offline-work)         | SHOULD | Offline, keep previews, editing and exports available when their data and implementation are available.                                                                                                                                                                                                             |                 |
| [W-SETTINGS-18](./WORKFLOW_PATTERNS.md#2-capability-aware-settings-and-offline-work)         | SHOULD | Offline, hide network-only discovery or promotion that offers no useful route; retain existing connected objects with an understandable unavailable state.                                                                                                                                                          |                 |
